description: This file defines a base activity class for Android applications, providing logging setup functionality and inheriting from FragmentActivity.

classes.name: SampleActivityBase
classes.description: A base class for Android activities that provides common setup, such as logging initialization.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Handles activity creation; currently only calls the superclass implementation.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Called when the activity becomes visible; it initializes logging.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging by attaching a LogWrapper and logging an 'Ready' message.
